name: initial state: a no-op event from another slice leaves the initial jsonClaude state
sessionStarted on a fresh session seeds a connecting session with ACP defaults
sessionStarted on a fresh codex session takes the payload agentKind, runtimeId, permission mode, capabilities and agentSessionId
sessionStarted with agentSessionId "" leaves agentSessionId absent
re-attach keeps agentKind, runtimeId, agentSessionId, title, entries and grants but resets exit bookkeeping
re-attach without an existing agentSessionId takes the payload one
re-attach drops an existing empty agentSessionId and title and ignores the payload agentSessionId
sessionStarted for a second session keeps the first in key order
agentSessionIdChanged sets agentSessionId on a known session
agentSessionIdChanged replaces an existing agentSessionId
agentSessionIdChanged is a no-op for an unknown session
sessionTitleChanged sets the title on a known session
sessionTitleChanged is a no-op for an unknown session
sessionStateChanged updates state and exit info
sessionStateChanged with null exit fields keeps the previous exit info
sessionStateChanged with absent exit fields keeps the previous exit info
sessionStateChanged with exitCode 0 and an empty exitReason overwrites
sessionStateChanged is a no-op for an unknown session
busyChanged toggles the busy flag
busyChanged is a no-op for an unknown session
sessionCleared drops the session and only its pending approvals
sessionCleared for an unknown session leaves approvals untouched
permissionModeChanged flips the mode
permissionModeChanged is a no-op for an unknown session
slashCommandsChanged replaces the per-session list
slashCommandsChanged is a no-op for an unknown session
capabilitiesChanged replaces a differing capability set
capabilitiesChanged with an identical set leaves the session alone
capabilitiesChanged is a no-op for an unknown session
entryAppended appends a user entry with images
entryAppended carries an auth-failure entry with authMethods
entryAppended carries subprocess-exit fields verbatim
entryAppended carries the protocol-version errorKind
entryAppended carries the runtime-missing errorKind
entryAppended carries the session-load-failed errorKind
entryAppended carries the rate-limit errorKind
entryAppended carries a rate-limit-warning with a fractional utilization and resetAt
entryAppended carries a rate-limit-error with a sparse detail
entryAppended carries a partial sub-agent assistant entry with every block shape
entryAppended carries system and compact entries
entryAppended is a no-op for an unknown session
entriesSeeded replaces the entries and marks them hydrated
entriesSeeded with an empty array still flips entriesHydrated
entriesSeeded is a no-op for an unknown session
assistantTextDelta appends to the last text block
assistantThinkingDelta appends to the last thinking block even without text
assistantTextDelta with an empty delta is a no-op
assistantTextDelta is a no-op when the entry has no text block
assistantThinkingDelta is a no-op when the entry has no blocks
assistantTextDelta is a no-op for an unknown entry
assistantThinkingDelta is a no-op for an unknown session
assistantBlockAppended pushes a block onto the entry
assistantBlockAppended creates blocks on an entry without any
assistantBlockAppended is a no-op for an unknown entry
assistantEntryFinalized replaces blocks and clears isPartial
assistantEntryFinalized drops isPartial false too
assistantEntryFinalized is a no-op for an unknown entry
toolResultAttached appends a tool_result entry stamped with now
toolResultAttached with an error result on an empty transcript
toolResultAttached is a no-op for an unknown session
compactBoundaryReceived appends a compact entry with metadata
compactBoundaryReceived omits absent metadata and keeps zero token counts
compactBoundaryReceived is a no-op for an unknown session
userEntriesUnqueued clears isQueued true and keeps isQueued false
userEntriesUnqueued is a no-op when nothing is queued
userEntriesUnqueued is a no-op for an unknown session
userEntryUnqueued clears only the targeted queued entry
userEntryUnqueued is a no-op when the target has isQueued false
userEntryUnqueued is a no-op when the target has no isQueued
userEntryUnqueued targets the queued entry when an earlier one shares its id
entryRemoved drops every entry with the id
entryRemoved is a no-op when the id is absent
entryRemoved is a no-op for an unknown session
entriesTruncated drops the target entry and everything after it
entriesTruncated at the first entry empties the transcript
entriesTruncated is a no-op when the id is absent
entriesTruncated is a no-op for an unknown session
approvalRequested adds a pending approval
approvalRequested carries a pending autoReview status
approvalRequested replacing an existing request keeps its key position
approvalResolved drops the request
approvalResolved for an unknown id is a no-op
approvalAutoApproved records the decision keyed by toolUseId
approvalAutoApproved is a no-op for an unknown session
approvalAutoReviewFinished sets a finished autoReview with model
approvalAutoReviewFinished without model leaves model absent
approvalAutoReviewFinished is a no-op for an unknown request
approvalSessionAllowed records an audit entry keyed by toolUseId
approvalSessionAllowed overwrites an existing toolUseId in place
approvalSessionAllowed is a no-op for an unknown session
sessionToolApprovalsGranted dedup-merges new tool names
sessionToolApprovalsGranted collapses existing duplicates when it adds a name
sessionToolApprovalsGranted is a no-op when nothing is new, even with existing duplicates
sessionToolApprovalsGranted is a no-op for an unknown session
sessionToolApprovalsCleared without toolNames clears the whole set
sessionToolApprovalsCleared with toolNames removes only those
sessionToolApprovalsCleared with an empty list is a no-op
sessionToolApprovalsCleared is a no-op for an unknown session
